summary: Discharge vs trial stage standard; prima facie case required under CrPC s.227; High Court wrongly conducted mini-trial by reappreciating prosecution evidence before trial; psychological profiling and BEOS tests cited as investigative tools; no eyewitness in murder case; neighborly relations negating enmity; scope of discharge limited to sufficiency of grounds, not truth or conviction probability; settled law requires presumption of prosecution evidence truthfulness.
final_judgment: High Court order set aside; respondents to face trial; appeal allowed.
